Summaries.eng: One day, Koyomi Araragi encounters the horrifying vampire, Kiss-shot Acerola-orion Heart-under-blade A.K.A. the "King of Apparitions." He saves the fatally wounded Kiss-shot by offering his blood at the expense of his own life as a human. Now Koyomi has to face the vampire hunters to retrieve Kiss-shot's limbs which were taken by these hunters.
Summaries.jpn:
高校二年生の阿良々木暦はある夜、伝説の吸血鬼であり、
“怪異の王”キスショット・アセロラオリオン・ハートアンダーブレードと
衝撃的な出会いを果たす。

まばゆいほどに美しく。
血も凍るほどに恐ろしく。
四肢を失い、痛々しくも無残な伝説の吸血鬼。

全ての〈物語〉はここから始まる―
